idea-plugin.name: Lark Connector
idea-plugin.description:
Lark Connector seamlessly embeds your Lark Base or Feishu task board directly inside Android Studio and IntelliJ IDEA.

Key Features

  • Embedded Chromium Engine: Fast, responsive Lark Base task tracking right inside your IDE.
  • Configurable Workspace URL: Easily set your custom Lark Base, Task Board, or Feed URL via Settings -> Tools -> Lark Connector.
  • Navigation Controls: Quick access toolbar to refresh views, navigate home, open in external browser, or adjust settings.
  • Dark Theme Synergy: Automatic Dark Theme parameter injection matching Android Studio's editor theme.
  • Zero Context Switching: Manage, update, and track daily Android development tasks without leaving your code editor.

Getting Started

  1. Install the plugin and open any project in Android Studio or IntelliJ.
  2. Click the Lark Connector tool window tab on the left sidebar.
  3. Configure your team's Lark Base URL in Settings / Preferences -> Tools -> Lark Connector.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Version 1.0.0

  • Initial release of Lark Connector plugin for JetBrains IDEs.
  • Added configurable Lark Base / Feishu URL settings panel.
  • Added JCEF Chromium browser integration with quick action toolbar (Refresh, Home, External Browser, Settings).
  • Added automatic dark mode URL parameter synchronization.
  • Added fallback support for environments without embedded JCEF.
